visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up static shot displays the lower half of a woman's face, focusing on skin pores and small blemishes. A prominent white logo for 'DRX Dermatology Clinic' sits at the top. Vibrant pink text asking 'What did she do?' pulses in the center while a 'Before' label appears at the bottom. (2) The scene shifts to a vertical split-screen showing a side-by-side 'Before' and 'After' comparison of a cheek. A beautician in white gloves and a dark blue uniform operates a grey and white 'Preime' skincare device on a patient's face. The lighting is bright and professional, highlighting skin improvements. (3) The camera focuses on the sleek white 'Preime' skincare station, displaying its various interchangeable heads and treatment bottles. A finger is seen tapping a large digital touchscreen interface to navigate through menu options, selecting specific body and face treatment protocols while the machine illuminates with a blue glow. (4) The beautician performs a cleansing step, massaging white foam onto the patient's face with gloved hands. A black headband holds the patient's hair back. Subsequently, a small white brush is used to paint a clear liquid across the forehead, while text overlays describe the chemical peeling process and its benefits. (5) Close-up macro shots depict the treatment head emitting a soft light as it moves over the patient's skin for deep nourishment. Three animated checkmarks appear sequentially on the left side of the frame, listing improvements like cleaning and pore reduction in Traditional Chinese text. (6) A medical-grade syringe dispenses a thick yellow liquid onto a gloved hand for application. The text emphasizes a 33% concentration of TCA. The patient lies still with eyes closed, showing a relaxed facial expression under bright, even studio lighting that highlights the glossy texture of the applied product. (7) A close-up view of a person's cheek shows fine, flaky skin peeling away six days post-treatment. The background is a plain indoor setting. This transition leads to a final static screen displaying the clinic's logo, phone number, and Line ID over a light grey abstract background with contact instructions.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as a promotional advertisement for DRX Dermatology Clinic, specifically showcasing their Preime skin treatment and TCA chemical peel procedure. By presenting a clear 'Before and After' hook followed by a step-by-step technical demonstration of the machine and professional application techniques, the video aims to build trust in the clinic's expertise and the effectiveness of the advanced technology, eventually encouraging viewers to contact the clinic for their own skin improvements.
